title: Devices with no compliance policy are treated as compliant

messages.businessImpact: Any device that no compliance policy reaches is reported as compliant and keeps access to company data. A gap in targeting becomes an invisible exemption rather than a visible failure.
messages.technicalDetail: The setting is Mark devices with no compliance policy assigned as, under Compliance policy settings.
remediation: Set the value to Not compliant.
Before changing it, confirm every intended device is targeted by a compliance policy, or the change will block users.
messages.cannotSee: Only the tenant-wide setting is read. Which devices no compliance policy reaches is a question of assignment coverage rather than of this setting.
